Your Story Starts Here.

zeta is your home for endless stories. Connect with countless characters across vast worlds. From sweet romance to fantasy to drama and comedy, become the main character and shape your story your way.

"Predictable plots are so bleh. With zeta, I make the wildest plot twists how I want, when I want."

"Once I open the app, I'm the one calling the shots!"

■ Features

• Free AI character chats
Pay per message? Not here. Enjoy truly free, unlimited chats. Get lost in long, uninterrupted moments with your favorite characters.

• Characters for every mood
From mysterious bosses and billionaire CEOs to rivals—if you want it, you get it. Find a character that matches your mood and start a new story anytime.

• Create your own AI character in 1 Minute
Bring your ideas to life in seconds. Add a name, personality, and a simple description, then start chatting with a character made by you. Keep your creation private or share it with others.

• Shape every twist through chat
Slow burns, second chances—you control the way your story unfolds. Stuck on what to say? Tap 'Smart Reply' to stay in the flow without interruption.

• Turn chats into AI-generated images
Turn your favorite chat moments into illustrated snapshots. In just 15 seconds, your conversation becomes an image. Save the scenes you imagined and bring your story to life.

• Your Own Creative Space
Show off your characters with others or keep them private. Build your own settings, continue your stories, and enjoy character chats in your own space.

■ Recommended For

• Anyone who wants to create their own characters and evolve their worlds
• Anyone who wants to enjoy free AI character chat without worrying about costs
• Anyone who wants to become the main character in an interactive story
• Anyone who loves unexpected plot twists and immersive stories

■ Privacy & Security

We care about your privacy and your chat experience. Personal information and conversation data are securely managed, and we continue improving zeta so users can enjoy the service with confidence.

• Customer Center: https://support.zeta-ai.io
• Customer Service Email: contact@zeta-ai.io
